Package neqsim.pvtsimulation.util

Class CompositionalReservoirHistory

java.lang.Object
neqsim.pvtsimulation.util.CompositionalReservoirHistory
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class CompositionalReservoirHistory extends Object implements Serializable
Measured component-history replay and bounded single-volume matching with a frozen laboratory-calibrated EOS.

Reuses SimpleReservoir's fixed-volume, isothermal TV flash. Every trial restores the accepted tuned fluid and the same initial pressure, temperature and phase-volume fractions. Only total initial pore volume is fitted. Pressure errors are independent supplied one-sigma scales; held-out pressures never enter the objective. Component amounts are measured inputs, so produced composition/GOR is not an independent prediction. An optional finite aquifer uses segregated immiscible water support. Rock expansion, energy balances, spatial displacement, correlated errors and EOS retuning are outside this bounded model.

Version:
1.0
Author:
Even Solbraa

    • replay

      public CompositionalReservoirHistory.Result replay(double initialVolumeM3, FetkovichAquifer aquifer)
      Replays a fixed-pore-volume tank coupled implicitly to segregated, immiscible finite-aquifer support.

      The aquifer integrates a linear reservoir-pressure path over each measured interval. Its water occupies We reservoir m3 separately; the existing tank TV flash closes the tracked EOS volume to initialVolumeM3 - We. Aquifer water neither mixes with nor can be produced through the measured component schedule. Initial EOS water remains tracked. No Bw conversion, invented water moles, thermal/rock expansion or water chemistry is applied. Reversal is allowed only while cumulative segregated water stays nonnegative. Check interval refinement for a nonlinear pressure trajectory.

      Parameters:
      initialVolumeM3 - total fixed initial pore volume in m3
      aquifer - immutable finite/constant-pressure aquifer, or null for no support
      Returns:
      pressure, aquifer, volume and component-balance evidence
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if pressure/volume closure or any interval is infeasible

    • fitVolume

      public CompositionalReservoirHistory.Fit fitVolume(double minimumVolumeM3, double maximumVolumeM3)
      Searches bounded log-volume using 17 grid trials and golden-section refinement of the best grid basin.

      Requires two calibration pressure observations. Failed trials are reported and excluded, never replaced by a pressure prediction. The bounds and fixed phase fractions are supplied geological assumptions. The search is a deterministic one-parameter estimate, not a global-optimum proof, posterior, confidence interval or EOS fit.

      Parameters:
      minimumVolumeM3 - positive lower pore-volume bound in m3
      maximumVolumeM3 - finite upper bound larger than the lower bound
      Returns:
      best complete replay with rejected-trial and bound diagnostics
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if no informative feasible calibration trials exist
